# US-001 — Read a plan authored under the removed bookkeeping fields

Compatibility background that is useful but is not the canonical user-story statement.

## User Story

As a release owner, I want an older plan to remain readable so that removing
orchestration fields never strands work that was already planned.

## Acceptance Criteria

- The coding runtime receives each active task's objective and assigned files.
- Optional Gherkin scenarios augment rather than replace the story Markdown.
